data.name: Menaka
data.gender_notes: Menaka is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Menaka is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'manda', meaning moon. In Hindu mythology, Menaka is the name of a celestial nymph, known for her beauty and intelligence. She is also identified with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. The name Menaka carries the meaning “Moon, Mind, Intelligence” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Menaka usually hope their child will grow to embody moon, mind, intelligence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of intelligence and wisdom.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Menaka total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
